why: aace1.org answers every request with a Cloudflare interstitial ('Just a moment...', HTTP 403) instead of a page. Tried the scripts/add_company.fetch client, curl with a desktop-Chrome User-Agent, and WebFetch, against https://www.aace1.org/, https://www.aace1.org/page/aaceconference, https://www.aace1.org/events/event_list.asp, https://www.aace1.org/page/2026AACEconference, /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml - all the same challenge. The ymaws CDN path used by sibling sites (cdn.ymaws.com/aace1.org/resource/resmgr/) returned 403 as well. Bot-detection is not something to work around, so no dates or city are recorded. Third-party pages carry a claim about the 36th Annual AACE Conference, but nothing from AACE's own site was ever read, so nothing is asserted.

quote: Upcoming ALGA Annual Conferences 2026: May 3-6, Cleveland, Ohio 2027: May 2-5, Denver, Colorado
note: algaonline.org itself is behind a Cloudflare interstitial (HTTP 403 to add_company.fetch, to curl with a desktop UA, and to WebFetch, including /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml), so the HTML site could not be read. The dates come from ALGA's OWN sponsorship prospectus PDF, served 200 from ALGA's own file store at cdn.ymaws.com/algaonline.org/, which also names 'algaonline.org' as the association's website. Marked medium rather than high because the document is the 2026 prospectus stating a forward-looking save-the-date, and ALGA's live conference page could not be reached to confirm it still holds. The 2026 edition (May 3-6, Cleveland, Ohio) is past.
The same page carries 'Date June 18 - 23, 2027' in its details block and 'Thank You for Joining Us in Boston / See you next year in Orlando!', so the 2026 Boston edition is past.

CITY is only medium, and here is exactly why: nsba.org's own 2027 conference page never names a city at all (it says 'Hotel map coming soon'), and the page contains no city name anywhere in its HTML. The city comes from NSBA's own 2027 Exhibitor & Sponsorship Prospectus PDF linked from that page, which states 'Exhibit with NSBA in Washington, D.C.' - but the SAME PDF also contains 'Experiential Learning Visits offer a rare opportunity to explore education in practice while in San Antonio', alongside other obviously recycled 2026 copy ('The 2026 awards focus on innovation in education'). Read the San Antonio line as stale carry-over and Washington, D.C. as the 2027 statement, but do not book a flight on this alone until nsba.org names the venue.
